alt: 孩子完成重要的舞台開場後走到布幕旁，放下麥克風，肩膀鬆了下來，閉眼長舒一口氣，老師在旁安心微笑。
scene_prompt: 如釋重負 means feeling deeply relieved when a difficult responsibility or worry is finally over. Contemporary school performance backstage immediately after the show. One child who had the important role of opening the performance now steps away from the stage curtain, eyes gently closed, exhaling with a broad relieved smile, shoulders visibly relaxed and both hands resting lightly over their chest. A simple microphone has been set safely on a small table and a closed unmarked script folder lies beside it; the stage beyond shows the successfully completed group bow, subtle small audience applauding in distance. A caring teacher nearby smiles reassuringly, indicating the child fulfilled the responsibility successfully. Main focus the child's released tension, not merely pride or celebration. No literal heavy sack needed. Two main foreground figures, anatomically coherent arms hands legs, natural relaxed posture and grounded furniture, no writing or text anywhere; soft pencil-watercolor-paper style.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2. NO text, letters, numerals, captions, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Clear visual storytelling for elementary school readers and readable at mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy browns, generous ivory breathing room. No flat digital blocks, glossy rendering, 3D or imitation of a named artist.
